svg.title: Mind Map Studio: search, the command palette and keyboard moves
svg.desc: A looping animation in two scenes. 1: Ctrl+F searches for price; the folded Marketing branch opens to show the match Price page, 1 of 2, and Enter moves to Price survey, 2 of 2. Ctrl+K opens the command palette and the arrow keys move through commands such as Go to Outline and Export SVG image. 2: the arrow keys move the selection from Q3 plan to Pricing to Tiers, following the right side of the map; F2 renames Tiers to Plan tiers, then the left arrow goes back to Pricing and the down arrow to Hiring.

g.text: ↑ ↓ to browse · Enter to run · Esc to close
Ctrl+F finds nodes even in folded branches. Ctrl+K runs any command.
Move and rename from the keyboard
Arrow keys follow the sides of the map; F2 renames, Enter keeps it.
